steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the permit to leave has been approved. You may take Eirene...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What's this?
Placing a pile of documents on your desk, Nightingale immediately notices that transparent chess piece.
Eirene sent it. I think it belongs to a chess set.
The rich sure are obsessed with these exquisite objects.
The chess piece made of transparent crystal is reflecting a dazzling light. Though it looks a bit bizarre, you're able to appreciate it somehow.
You pick up the documents on the desk, consider briefly, and decide to put that chess piece in your pocket.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: 98% of the routes in WhiteSands are controlled by the Campbell family. Although they're all being monitored by the FAC currently, considering you're taking Eirene with you... Chief, the FAC advised that you bring a larger team.
I'll think about it. But first, I have to invite Miss Eirene to come with me.
In the room, Eirene sits in the same posture as she did when you first met her, her gaze focusing on the chessboard on the desk.

options: Sorry to interrupt you, Miss Eirene.

choices.text: Sorry to interrupt you, Miss Eirene.

steps.content: Eirene remains silent. You suppose you've got her permission, so you walk into the room and stare at the state of play on the desk with her.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Please speak plainly if you want anything, Chief.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I don't think you've squeezed out time from your busy schedule just to rack your brains over this endgame with me.
As far as I know, it's still possible to win during the endgame in chess.
I've long heard about your gift for chess, Miss Eirene. Don't you want to reverse the situation in this endgame?
Eirene finally lifts her gaze from the chessboard and looks at you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Go ahead, state your purpose.
Thank you for your cooperation last time. Based on our investigation, we've judged that Bryce Campbell has become more dangerous and he may be in touch with other Sinners besides you.
That's why I'm taking a trip to Fraser City for the investigation, and I hope you could come with me.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...What are you talking about?
Eirene frowns and seems unable to comprehend the meaning of your words.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You're inviting Eirene Campbell, Bryce Campbell's daughter, to go back to Fraser City with you?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I can't tell whether you're overconfident or simply out of your mind.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Aren't you afraid that my father and I may take advantage of your arrival and launch an attack on the DisCity?
There's a hint of sarcasm in Eirene's tone. She lifts her hand and pushes a black piece near the opponent's king.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Chief, do you want to lead this endgame toward a victory... or a failure?
You sit in the chair facing Eirene and produce the permit to leave and the transparent chess piece.
It all depends on which path you decide to take, Miss Eirene.
You're now a Sinner detained by me. As long as I wish, you can't defy my orders. But I won't go as far as that for now. The MBCC needs you and is going to help you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Ha... For now, you said.

options: I know you're trying to break free from him.

choices.text: I know you're trying to break free from him.

steps.content: Eirene lapses into silence. Her two hands on the desk are clenched, to the point her fingernails are turning white.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: In that case... Let's have a game of chess, Chief.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: In the past, whenever I felt lost, I would play a match with my father.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Thinking about the steps helps me clarify my mind and see ahead clearly.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I hope you won't turn me down.
But I'm not good at chess.
That's an understatement. In fact, you only just went through the rules of chess as you were investigating this chess piece today.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: That won't be a problem. A player pays the same respect to every opponent.
You nod and scoot forward slightly to begin a game with Eirene.
But you're certain you have no chance of winning at all.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Hehe...
...What's so funny?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: What you just said reminds me of my own words when I played chess with my father for the first time.
Smiling, Eirene looks at you and turns the chessboard to set the white pieces before you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I said, "You're too good, father, you'll defeat me in seconds."

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Then he moved the white pieces to my side, and told me that... "In any case, making the first move means victory."
Gestured by Eirene, you pick up a white piece and consider for a good while before deciding to move the white pawn two squares forward.

options: Are you taking advantage of me?

choices.text: Are you taking advantage of me?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Hmm, a very steady first move.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You must be joking... Taking such trivial advantage of you won't do Quinn any good.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But that game indeed ended quickly.
Eirene's fingers brush against a piece gently, pick it up, and set it on the chessboard sharply.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: My father didn't treat me as a beginner at all, and kept attacking mercilessly, even ignoring the position of the king.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: He taught me with this ruthless match that a businessman ought to have the decisiveness to kill without hesitation, and...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: The resilience to never bow down and give up no matter how bleak the situation is.
Though I'm no businessman, I'll try to struggle for a bit longer.
It seems to me that you lost that game but won Mr. Bryce's recognition.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Who knows? I only remember bawling my eyes out.
A child's pride is much more stubborn than we think. A trial like that is indeed quite cruel.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You think that's cruel?
The woman before you picks up a piece, the black rook, and pushes a white piece on the board gently with it. The white piece standing there falls immediately, tumbling on the board.
Eirene sets the black piece on that square and gives a self-mocking laugh.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: My father has given me many more trials after this checkmate.
The night has fallen. Under the moonlight, the sand of WhiteSands appears even more desolate.

Not far away, an enormous structure is docked near the fine quicksand. It's a WhiteSands freighter. It's so close to the quicksand, looking like it may get pulled at any moment into these seeming feeble swirls that can devour everything.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Unload as many of the goods as you can, but our primary target is that girl!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit A
steps.content: Boss, it's just a girl, wouldn't this be overkill? How can she make it out of WhiteSands alive without this ship?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Humph, do you think she's the same as those pampered fat cats around you?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: She's a Campbell! She can escape WhiteSands with her eyes closed!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Moreover... This time, someone is paying a fortune to make her...
The desert bandits exchange a look and burst out in disgusting laughter.
Daisy
Frightened of the desert bandits? No, it's the person paying a fortune that she's frightened of.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Daddy...
The desert bandits are approaching this hold. The girl grips the handgun tightly, trying hard to calm down.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: White... E3.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: NO!!! I'm not waiting for anyone! NOBODY IS COMING!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit B
steps.content: Boss! There's a hold below!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: That's for storing ropes, a person won't fit in there. But just in case, take a look to see if they've got anything valuable hidden in there!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit B
steps.content: Alrighty!
The desert bandit lifts the plank at the entrance and jumps down, but the moment he turns, he faces the black hole of the barrel.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Take this!
A gunshot sounds. Without splashing out much fluid, the desert bandit exits the chessboard before he can even notify anyone.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: That girl is right below! Fire!!

The girl keeps her crouching position and fires back at the converging enemies the best she can. The bullets going in the reverse direction carry determination, piercing through the desert bandits trying to get close to her.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Don't ******* just shoot through the entrance! Aim at the deck! Fetch me those weapons!
A large machine gun shining in an eerie red light is carried there by several desert bandits. The moment the boss pulls the trigger, the bullet rips through the hard deck and barely misses the girl.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: What the h*** is that?! If this goes on...
With a clack, the girl's handgun stops, leaving only a few strands of smoke in the air.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Damn it!
Hearing that the gunshots below have stopped, the boss gives a wicked laugh and pulls the ring off the hand grenade.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: I wanted to let you keep your pretty face, but I guess you want a taste of my favorite trick... Hehe, hahahaha!
The hand grenade rolls into the hold. The smell of the burning detonator and overwhelming fear have paralyzed the girl's nerves. For a moment, her head is swimming.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: You're pretty tough to have held us off for so long. You're indeed a Campbell.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: That's right, because I'm a Campbell...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: At the very least... I won't let this warship that carries our honor fall into the hands of your sort!
At that moment, the girl has already made her decision. She crawls out from the ruins of the stairs and begins executing every step of her strategy.
She tries her best to steady her mind and picks up that hand grenade with shaky hands, gripping it.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Let's hope you're powerful enough to at least blow up the next two holds.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: You sure fight hard, but is it harder than my ****? Hahahaha!
The girl ignores the cackling desert bandits on the deck, focusing only on the dwindling hiss.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Just... catch this!
At the final moment, she throws the hand grenade backward and leaps behind the iron petition.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandits
steps.content: For ****'s sake!
Boom!
The hand grenade embedded with a bizarre crystal is several times more powerful than regular ones. It's almost blown up the whole deck, and a few neighboring holds have completely collapsed.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Argh! Find that girl first! Even if I have to break this ship up, I must throw her ashes in this WhiteSands!!

Furious, the desert bandit picks up an iron bar randomly and swings it violently. But wherever they search, they don't find any signs of life in these ruins. Only a puddle of fluid mixed with filth keeps spreading little by little.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit A
steps.content: Boss! There's a secret passage leading upward!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit A
steps.content: It seems to be... leading to the cockpit!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: What?!
The desert bandits immediately run back to the rails to confirm the situation. As expected, the ship has already been launched, and the front half is almost sinking into quicksand!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: You ****! If I must die on this ship, you'll **** die with me!!
The boss snatches a gun and kicks the cockpit's door open.
Trembling, the girl is operating the control stick with one hand, her other hand resting on a red button. The liquid dripping from her fingertips gathers on the button, as if she has dyed it red.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Buried in quicksand... or buried in flames...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I... Cough, I do have mercy for you... I'm letting you choose.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: Shut the **** up! Do you know who paid to have you killed? Bryce Campbell!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Boss
steps.content: And you're still guarding his ship like a ******* idiot?! Stop it, now! ****!

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: OwO

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I... Eirene Campbell... will protect the Campbell family's honor with my life.
The girl presses the button gently.

In the last conscious moment, she sees the desert bandits' contorted faces, and feels the deafening and pungent explosion, just like the gun salute her father fired at the Campbell family's coming of age ceremony.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Congratulations, you're a grown-up now, Eirene.
